title: Business Central Under the Hood episode 10: Hackers Are at the Gate! Business Central & Security.

features.name: Secure by Default Initiative
features.description: Microsoft's approach to make software security the default state where systems are secure upon deployment, requiring explicit configuration changes to weaken security. This aligns with the Secure Future Initiative.
caveats: Not specific to Business Central alone but applies across BIC products

features.name: Threat Intelligence Sharing Network
features.description: Business Central customers benefit from a network effect where threat intelligence is shared across the cloud platform with partners like Google, Amazon, and Apple. When an attack or compromise is detected, the information can be cascaded to all customers immediately.
caveats: Benefit is specific to cloud-hosted Business Central customers

features.name: Security Development Lifecycle
features.description: All Business Central code goes through professional security team review including threat modeling exercises, risk assessment, and mitigation tracking before release.
caveats: Requires conducting 6-7 security reviews per day
Maintained even during AI feature pressure

features.name: Static Code Analysis and Scanning
features.description: Business Central code undergoes static analysis and code scanning to identify potential security vulnerabilities before release.
caveats: Most small businesses do not perform this practice

features.name: Secure Admin Workstation (SAW)
features.description: Specialist devices used to access production systems that are completely separate from corporate systems, locked down, require physical security dongle and second factor authentication.
caveats: Requires UB key physical dongle
Requires second factor authentication
Specialist VPN required

features.name: Auditing and Security Logs to Purview
features.description: Business Central ships extensive auditing and security logs to Microsoft Purview so customers can create their own alerts and detect anomalies.
features.status_evidence_quote: we ship an awful lot of auditing and security logs to purview so that customers can can see can also make their own alerts
caveats: Part of joint responsibility model
Enables customer-side anomaly detection

features.name: Dynamics 365 Bounty Program
features.description: Microsoft pays security researchers to responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in Dynamics 365 and Business Central rather than selling them as zero-day exploits.
caveats: Bounty amounts can be substantial
Payment, CVE credit, and name attribution provided

features.name: Cloud Bugs Transparency Reporting
features.description: Microsoft started reporting all cloud bugs including those without CVE assignments to increase transparency about vulnerabilities found and fixed in Business Central.
caveats: Previously only reported bugs with CVE assignments

features.name: Business Central red team exercise
features.description: Security testing exercise conducted in 2019 with Microsoft red team members who attempted to hack Business Central using the same techniques as skilled adversaries. Led to cleanup work and revealed unexpected security issues.
caveats: exercise conducted in 2019
some cleanup work required

features.name: Security development lifecycle guidance
features.description: Framework and guidance for partners and developers to follow for secure development. Includes resources on threat modeling, identity management, multifactor authentication, and other security practices.

features.name: CISO workshops
features.description: Video resources with accompanying decks aimed at chief information security officers covering security assurance, operational security, security architecture, and posture management.

features.name: Component governance tooling
features.description: Internal tools used to identify and track vulnerabilities in component dependencies. Tools analyze dependencies and alert when vulnerabilities are found so patches can be applied before shipping.

features.name: Threat modeling methodology
features.description: Process for identifying security risks by diagramming systems, identifying trust boundaries, analyzing with attacker mindset, and determining mitigations. Described as deceptively simple and involving sitting down as a team to understand system components and connections.

features.name: Fishing resistant multifactor authentication
features.description: Advanced MFA implementation using passkeys and other methods that require proof of presence and prevent spoofing attacks. Prevents man-in-the-middle attacks by using Bluetooth range or barcode verification.
caveats: explicitly not SMS
requires compatible devices

features.name: Copilot threat modeler
features.description: AI-powered copilot assistant that helps with threat modeling by watching transcripts and answering questions about security patterns and SDL controls. Helps security professionals remember and apply hundreds of security controls.
caveats: still being developed
human still needs to remember controls

features.name: AI for attack detection and log analysis
features.description: AI tools used to detect anomalies and patterns in network logs and events, finding outliers that indicate potential security threats by identifying things not fitting established patterns across large datasets.
caveats: Can generate alert fatigue and false positives

features.name: Dynamics 365 and Power Platform security heat mapping
features.description: A capability to assess security maturity and risk across hundreds of services that make up Dynamics 365 and Power Platform products, creating a heat map to identify which services need more security support based on inherent risk and attack surface.
caveats: Different services have varying security maturity levels and complexity

features.name: AI-assisted incident response
features.description: Using AI systems and tools to compress telemetry data and cross-reference compromised identities and systems during security incidents, significantly reducing investigation time from months to weeks.
caveats: Even with AI assistance, incident response at scale remains complex
